findings.desc: Recovery smoke does not fully prove the operator-visible cleanup transcript promised by CHK-004. Fresh run of npm --prefix packages/main run test:worktree-repair-smoke passes, but the recovery assertion only checks "partial-DONE recovered" and "story/<id> merged into main" in packages/main/src/tasks/worktree-repair-smoke.ts:225-227. The command output also promises worktree-removal and branch-deletion lines from packages/main/src/core/partial-done-recovery.ts:185-197 and packages/main/src/handlers/done-recover.ts:75-77, yet the smoke covers those only via final git/fs state at lines 229-235. This leaves the must intent for operator-visible recovery output under-proved.

[HIGH] packages/main/src/handlers/done-recover.ts:32-85 runs a main-affecting recovery path without acquiring the DONE main-merge lock introduced in packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:122-135 and used by story_advance at packages/main/src/handlers/story-advance.ts:152-159. done_recover merges into main, removes the worktree, and deletes the story branch after only a point-in-time main cleanliness check, so a concurrent story_advance --phase=DONE or second done_recover can interleave and mutate the same repo state. Fix by taking the same done-main-merge lock for the full done_recover critical section before merge/worktree cleanup begins.

[HIGH] packages/main/src/core/partial-done-recovery.ts:179-199 force-removes the story worktree whenever plain git worktree remove fails, then recursively deletes any residue, but this recovery path never proves that the target worktree is clean. That differs from the normal DONE cleanup contract documented in packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:429-432, where forced deletion is only considered safe after the DONE gate has already verified a clean worktree and a merged branch. In partial-DONE recovery this can erase unrelated uncommitted edits or drafts left in .worktrees/B-xxx. Fix by checking the target worktree status first and refusing recovery until the operator commits, stashes, or inspects non-runtime changes, or restrict forced deletion to explicitly whitelisted runtime residue only.

packages/main/src/handlers/done-recover.ts:39-80 performs main safety checks, merge into main, worktree cleanup, and branch deletion without acquiring the new done-main-merge global lock. That bypasses the serialized DONE critical section introduced in this story, so koala done_recover can race a concurrent story_advance --phase=DONE and recreate the same main-mutation / partial-DONE hazard the fix is meant to prevent. Fix by acquiring the same DONE main-merge lock before re-reading partial-DONE state and holding it through merge, worktree cleanup, and branch deletion; add a contention smoke that proves done_recover vs DONE cannot run concurrently.
